purpose: Six-skill learned control and chaining feasibility before wider workspace development
evaluation_policy: Do not inspect evaluation outcomes or generate teacher trajectories from these seeds until the candidate and inference configuration are frozen. Retain every final outcome.
initial_diagnostic: Seed 42 feasibility collection is exposed and not a holdout. It may be included in training.
training_eligibility: Teacher succeeds; saved float32 nominal 20 Hz motor endpoints physically replay to release and parked arms without hidden forces or state writes.
data_gate: Inspect failures before adding further batches. No failed episode becomes training eligible by exclusion of a failed metric.
model_family: Per-skill image-conditioned neural motion primitives, then explicit motor-feedback sequencing; continuous visual correction is a separate measured addition.
promotion: Each advertised skill must physically succeed, all six must compose without resetting, final fresh ten-seed outcomes must be reported. A weaker skill remains unavailable rather than silently falling back to the programmed teacher.
perturbations: Current task preset: object placement up to 9 mm, cutlery up to 3 mm, yaw, mass +/-8%, friction +/-10%, lighting 0.92-1.06. Shape/background and wider positions require separate protocols.
